pretreatments.description: Dilute citric acid pretreatment of sugarcane bagasse with temperature (T), time (t), and percentage by weight of citric acid (PCA) as operational variables, using a 2^3 Doehlert experimental design (DED) with five replicates at the center point (CP) and investigating the effects of these variables on the accessibility of the cellulose fraction and biogas production.

Enzymatic hydrolysis of pretreated sugarcane bagasse using Cellic® CTec 3 HS cocktail under operational parameters (temperature of 45–50 °C and pH of 5.0–5.5) with a liquid-to-solid ratio of 10 mL g^−1, an initial enzyme concentration of 10 FPU g^−1, and a fixed reaction time of 72 h.

Anaerobic digestion of black liquor (BL) and residual solid fraction (RSF) obtained after pretreatment of sugarcane bagasse and enzymatic hydrolysis, using a mesophilic condition (35.1 ± 0.3 °C) and 200 rpm agitation, with a F/I ratio of 0.4 gVS gVS^−1, and a chemical composition of sodium bicarbonate (pH buffer) and micro- and macronutrients.
